# Commit ids before and after the history rewrite of 21 October 2026
#
# At the student's request, every commit message lost its "Co-Authored-By: Claude ..." line.
# Of the 225 commits, the first two carried no line and kept their ids (56d3df6, 9455441).
# The other 223 were rebuilt with the same tree, authors and dates, and parents that map to
# the old ones, checked pair by pair against a mirror of the old history. Ids quoted inside
# messages were mapped as well.
# An id from before 10 October goes through commit-map.txt first, then this map.
# Written by git filter-repo: the old id first, the new id second. The steps are in
# docs/guides/git-coauthor-cleanup.md.
#
